funding.name: Pre-seed — Setup
funding.note: 3 months pre-launch (Oct–Dec 2026): Curaçao-licensed company purchase, legal, first operational hires, content & platform agreements — plus the initial launch marketing.

funding.name: Seed — Launch
funding.note: Lands at launch (Jan 2027). Funds the first 5 months live (Jan–May 2027): platform build, core team, first marketing in every market — enough to produce real cohort data — plus the house bankroll (reserve) carried from day one.

funding.name: Seed extension — Prove
funding.note: Raised on 5 months of live cohorts (CPA, retention, payback by market). Funds Jun–Oct 2027 (M9–M13), up to the scale-up.

funding.name: Series A — Accelerate ($10M)
funding.note: Closes Nov 2027 (M14) on 7 months of live cohorts at or above plan. Buys a ×3 marketing step (instead of ×2), the expansion phase from day one and the team a year earlier. Payback is fast, so the bigger step is largely self-funding; the round is sized so this path survives CPA +20% and retention −15% together with no further raise.
